newsitem.title: USA: American International names Smith CFO. [corrected 18:13 gmt]
newsitem.headline: American International names Smith CFO. [corrected 18:13 gmt]

text.p: American International Group Inc said Monday its board elected Executive Vice President and Comptroller Howard Smith to the position of chief financial officer, effective immediately. (Company corrects to make clear that the position is not newly created and said Smith will take over reponsibilities previously held by Edward E. Matthews, who will continue as AIG Vice Chairman of Investments and financial services.)
The company also said the board elected Pei-yuan Chia, former vice chairman of Citicorp, as a director, and Louis Zearo and Theodore Rupley as vice presidents.
Chia will advise senior management on expansion opportunities worldwide, the company said.
Smith will remain executive vice president and comptroller while adding responsibility for treasury, investor relations and credit functions.

The company said William Smith, executive vice president of domestic general insurance, resigned for personal reasons. Thomas Tizzio, senior executive for general insurance, will assume William Smith's duties, the company said.
AIG is among the largest underwriters of commercial and industrial insurance in the United States.
